name: Beached Sea Creature
summary: Along Darkshore's rocky Twilight Shore, a colossal thresher lies stranded, far larger than any known local specimen. Its death and stranding add to the deep-sea troubles worrying the night elves.

sections.title: A Giant Cast Ashore
sections.body: You find driftwood and sea debris along the Twilight Shore in southern Darkshore, but one inlet holds the remains of an enormous thresher. Tides and scavengers have begun picking it apart, yet its skeleton dwarfs ordinary predators in these coastal shallows. The giant is an outsider to these waters. Sickness or disorientation may have driven it onto the rocks, or some deeper disturbance may lie out in the Veiled Sea.

sections.title: The Temple's Vigil
sections.body: In Auberdine, priestesses of the Temple of the Moon study the dead giants washing ashore. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde oversees the gathering of skeletal samples to learn why deep-dwelling predators are dying. Colossal threshers were once seen near Teldrassil's roots, but their numbers have fallen steadily. The priestesses fear the marine balance off Kalimdor's northern coast is unraveling.

faq.q: What kind of beast is this beached carcass?
aliases: what is the beached sea creature
faq.answer: The carcass is the skeleton of an immense predatory sea beast called a thresher. It is several times larger than the common threshers along Darkshore's coast.

faq.q: Where did this creature originally come from?
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde says creatures of this immense size once roamed the waters near Teldrassil, but their numbers have steadily declined. This thresher is not native to Darkshore's immediate shallows.

faq.q: Why is the Temple of the Moon studying these carcasses?
aliases: temple of the moon sea creatures
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon studies the carcasses to understand why sea beasts are washing ashore along Darkshore. By examining bones and remains, the priestesses hope to learn whether corruption, disease, or outside forces are driving deep-sea creatures onto land.

faq.q: Where should the bones be brought?
aliases: where to turn in sea creature bones
faq.answer: Bring the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a night elf researcher in Auberdine's harbor town.

faq.q: Where on the coast is this carcass located?
faq.answer: The carcass lies in a rocky inlet along the Twilight Shore, Darkshore's southern coast.

faq.q: Are there other creatures beaching themselves in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Yes. Several kinds of sea beasts and behemoths have washed ashore along Darkshore's coast, prompting researchers in Auberdine to investigate.

angles.text: The unexplained decline and beaching of sea life near Teldrassil troubles the Kaldorei, who look to Elune and the Temple of the Moon for meaning in such omens.
Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde studies the sea under the Temple of the Moon, seeking balance and divine insight through close inquiry into its waters.
The stranding of great sea predators signals an ecosystem in distress, a concern shared by the Cenarion Circle throughout Darkshore.
